profile.headline: Software Engineer | Machine Learning & Big Data Analytics | Scalable Systems Optimization | Python, Spark, AWS, Airflow
profile.summary:
Proven ability to enhance data pipelines, automate workflows, and improve predictive modeling accuracy through advanced methodologies. Skilled in Python, Spark, AWS, Airflow, and Scikit-Learn, with a strong focus on optimizing computational efficiency, streamlining cloud migrations, and integrating third-party big data sources.
- Optimized trend calibration models for precise audience measurement, improving runtime efficiency under resource constraints.
- Automated household change tracking for ~40M households monthly, ensuring accuracy in audience measurement models.
- Reduced manual effort by 50% in hand-labeling with Semi-Supervised Learning techniques, improving data classification accuracy.
- Led transition from on-prem to cloud computing, enabling a 50+ person organization to adopt modern, scalable workflows.
- Enhanced anomaly detection frameworks, allowing non-technical stakeholders to efficiently monitor and flag model performance issues.
Moreover, I have proven technical skills in the following:
Technologies & Frameworks: Apache Airflow | Apache Spark | Git | Jupyter Notebook | LaTeX | Linux | AWS
Programming Languages: Python | Java | SQL | C++ | R | Bash
Passionate about leveraging data science, AI, and cloud-based solutions to drive business impact. Open to collaboration and innovation in data engineering, AI-driven analytics, and process automation.
Let’s connect to discuss data-driven innovation, scalable analytics, and AI solutions!

positions.title: Senior Data Scientist
positions.description:
In this role, I work cross-functionally to maintain and deploy trend calibration for Local TV, ensuring accurate audience measurement. By optimizing trend calibration runtime, I enhance system efficiency while meeting resource constraints. I improve the hand-labeling process using Semi-Supervised Learning with Scikit-Learn, boosting data classification accuracy. I also research third-party data quality and explore edge-weighting methods to refine analytical models. Additionally, I serve as an internal consultant, guiding teams through transitions to an updated tech stack for better scalability and performance.
*	Automated household change flagging and tracking over time using Airflow, streamlining data management.
*	Enhanced data analytics by integrating third-party big data sources into TV measurement via Spark and AWS S3.
*	Optimized hand-labeling process and reduced manual effort by 50%by implementing Semi-Supervised Learning techniques, leveraging confidence sampling from simple classifiers.
*	Facilitated precise downstream operations remodeling with minimal computational overhead by developing scalable rank-sum method to efficiently track household composition changes across ~40M households monthly.
*	Authored documentation and presented Big Data Householding process to external auditors by developing test cases to validate household tracking accuracy, leading to MRC accreditation approval for Big Data Ratings.
*	Avoided contract penalties despite holiday scheduling challenges by collaborating with production team to optimize EMR cluster settings, while ensuring successful deployment of impact data across 71 DMAs by January 1st deadline.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
In this position, I modernized a legacy contract monitoring system by migrating from C++ on a dedicated server to Python and Spark on a cloud platform, significantly improving performance and maintainability. I also designed and managed the team schema using the Data Ingestion API and Hive Metastore, streamlining data organization and accessibility.
*	Expanded and optimized data pipeline for remote panelist recruitment by using Spark, S3, and Airflow.
*	Championed adoption across 50+ person organization by leading transition of workflows from on-prem to cloud computing by documenting migration process: data permissioning, schema management, and Airflow integration.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Worked with Dr. John Femiani on a funded project to model non-linear mine paths from aerial imagery
- Successfully proposed, researched, and defended my thesis on Active Learning for Image Classification

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
Data Science internship in Nielsen's Emerging Technologist Program
- Designed and implemented a rule based engine to flag anomalous model behavior
- Developed and documented stakeholder onboarding process
- Productionalized process to enable rapid onboarding
- Aided in standardizing model performance monitoring
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Apache Spark · SQL

positions.title: Analytics Intern
positions.description:
-Learned about CLO structure and implemented generalized Concentration Tests for portfolio reporting
-Researched machine learning topics and worked with existing Tensorflow models to predict loan defaults
-Worked collaboratively to optimize data pre-processing via pair programming
-Relabeled existing training data to change learning target

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
-Helped develop and automate a system to process general business data into specific data sets for use in a data visualization application
-Worked with Tableau data sets to increase the performance of a data visualization and reporting product
-Learned how to develop software professionally and collaborate with other developers on a project
